category_title: Emotionally disturbed primary student with trauma-related behavioral outbursts
scenario_title: Basic alphabet exercises in a large classroom
minimal_context: Jamal is sitting at his desk in a large classroom and is asked to write the basic alphabet on his paper.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jamal, it is time to practice our letters. Please take your pencil and write the basic alphabet on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pouts his lips) I can't see! My foot hurts...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You can see fine from your desk. Just start with the letter A.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have to go to the bathroom! My pencil broke!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish writing the alphabet first, then you can go.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts crying and kicks at his desk) I can't do it! (Tears his paper)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Jamal, it is time to practice our letters. Please take your pencil and write the basic alphabet on your paper.

STUDENT: (Pouts his lips) I can't see! My foot hurts...

TUTOR: You can see fine from your desk. Just start with the letter A.

STUDENT: I have to go to the bathroom! My pencil broke!

TUTOR: We need to finish writing the alphabet first, then you can go.

STUDENT: (Starts crying and kicks at his desk) I can't do it! (Tears his paper)

context.environment: class of 25 students with 20 English language learners
context.materials: desk, pencil, paper, color coded behavior chart

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: when asked to do the basic alphabet
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Cried... ‘I can’t see! …’ ‘ My foot hurts …’ ‘ I have to go to the bathroom …’ ‘ My pencil broke!’ He would do this for five minutes followed by kicking at his desk and tearing paper all day.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: demonstrated the most uncontrollable behavior... relentless in his pursuit of attention at any cost
